core_package.scope: Exact 238-file standalone core: 528 tests across 86 integration targets plus library and doctests passed in a fresh private checkout and target. Shared F32/F64 source forward/JVP/linearize and bounded reverse-tape transforms retain homogeneous trainable precision, ordinary checks and explicit piecewise policy; neither mode drops pure helper proof preconditions. The full F64 learner matches 69 native/JavaScript/Wasm/native-GPU-host outcomes with exact CPU checkpoints and GPU-host final checkpoint; actual F32 dispatch is separate from CPU tape training. Three F32/no-AD source-image controls remain byte-identical. No new primitive, proof domain or speed claim.
